name: Rollforge Tycoon
tagline: Roll rare loot, build a factory, rebirth forever
description: An endless roll-and-place tycoon in 3D pixel art. Roll up an endless rarity ladder, build a production line, defend your base and rebirth.
longDescription: Roll for items on an endless rarity ladder, keep them in your backpack and place them on a grid to build a production line that earns money. Level up for bigger rolls, rebirth into endless prestige regions and defend your base from waves and bosses. Everything you see and hear is generated by code, your save stays on your device, and it is free in the browser.
controls: Open Roll, Backpack, Base, Shop and the other panels: 1-9
Place: an item's Place button, then click a tile (R rotates)
Pan / orbit / zoom: WASD or drag / Q E or right-drag / wheel
Undo the last place, move or sale: Z
Fights: M takes manual control, then WASD move, F fire, Shift dash
Touch: a touch bar while placing and a virtual joystick in fights
